title: Affine opens of a separated scheme over an affine base intersect in affine opens
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] (its diagonal $Y\to Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}Y$ is a closed immersion, hence an affine morphism, so $f$ has affine diagonal). If $U,V\subseteq Y$ are affine open subschemes, then $U\cap V$ is an affine open subscheme. Consequently, if $Y=U_0\cup\cdots\cup U_n$ with all $U_j$ affine, then for $V=U_1\cup\cdots\cup U_n$ the open $U_0\cap V=\bigcup_{j\ge1}(U_0\cap U_j)$ is covered by $n$ affine opens.

source.place: Lemma Tag 01KP (lemma-characterize-separated (1)(a): f separated, U, V affine opens mapping into a common affine open of S, then U ∩ V affine) and morphisms.tex Lemma Tag 01SE (lemma-closed-immersion-affine: closed immersions are affine); used in etale-cohomology.tex, proof of Lemma Tag 0A51 ('using that the diagonal of X is affine')
